lede: The Telluride Hospital District board meets August 27 with a major decision on the table: possible action on a Two Site Model for the new medical facility, plus movement on architect selection and a Letter of Intent — choices that will shape the future of healthcare in this valley for decades. Also worth watching that same day, the TMVOA board votes to stand up a Workforce Housing Committee and act on updated policies, while the Town's brand-new Resident Advisory Committee holds its inaugural meeting to begin giving employee-housing tenants a real seat at the table on rental policy.

notable.stake: Board may vote on Two Site Model and architect selection for new hospital facility.
TMVOA votes to form Workforce Housing Committee and adopt updated association policies.
New tenant advisory body holds first meeting; chair election and policy scope set here.
